levels.surface: عبد الله بن محمد بن عقيل
عبد الله بن محمد بن عقيل

notes: ورواه ... remark: the variant route via Ubayd Allah, Ibn Jurayj and Sharik is a variant group, never a route; Ibn Jurayj's own wording Umar is left out of its names.
Al-Tirmidhi's comments, the scholars' views and the question put to Muhammad are not routes.
عمه عمران and أمه حمنة: uncle and mother are written with a name, so the name alone is the link (rule 7).
